targetEvidence.note: lifecycle events observed in source; window.sireader exposes mount/open only, no stats getter

effectiveTimeRule: wall time while reader holds document focus and host window is visible; blur/tab-switch/hidden/mobile-close settles the fragment; local-date midnight split; multi-instance and multi-window independent

consumer.writePolicy: one idempotent event per qualifying local day; user tombstone never rewritten
consumer.fallback: SireaderFocusTracker listens to the same four events, opt-in default-off, experimental until upstream ships
consumer.canonicalSourceRule: upstream contract becomes canonical only after merge + release + real-host acceptance; fallback demotes to diagnostic compare; never double-count

forbidden: book titles or URLs in event payloads
privacy.identity: bounded anonymous book identity only, optional
